story: Nifty 50 opened at 25,202, a gap-down of 0.39% from the previous close of 25,299.
The index dipped to a low of 25,054 (-0.97%) around 2:20 PM and touched a high of 25,246 (-0.21%) around 10:45 AM.
It settled at 25,144 (-0.61%), in the middle of the day's range, a session of two-way trade.
10 of the 50 Nifty stocks advanced and 38 declined; Bank Nifty moved in line (-0.79%).
Latest institutional data (11 Nov): FII/FPI net +12563 Cr, DII net -8435 Cr.
risks: Markets stay shut until Monday (3 days): weekend news, geopolitics and any Wall Street or Asian moves will all be priced in at the open.
Wall Street trades through tonight (from about 7:00 PM IST); the S&P 500 last closed at 7,592.40 (-0.35%), so US data and Fed commentary can swing the opening.
Brent crude is at US$95.49 (-0.34%); no sharp move so far, but it is a swing factor for inflation and the rupee.
Currency and yields to track: USD/INR 94.230 (+0.57%), US 10-year yield 5.10% (+2.10%). A firmer dollar or higher US yields usually weigh on foreign flows.
GIFT Nifty keeps trading into the late evening, now 25,173.5 (+0.12% vs Nifty's close): the best live read on the next opening.
